events.text: Northbridge FC open talks with Riverside FC to sign Leo Silva before the window closes.
Southport Athletic bid 57M for Leo Silva.
Southport Athletic raise their bid for Leo Silva to 60.5M.

The window closes. Leo Silva joins Southport Athletic instead, for 60.5M, because Northbridge FC could not agree the fee (Northbridge's last offer was 50M plus up to 15M in add-ons, the asking price was 70M).

transcript.message: We’re making our opening bid of 39.5M for Leo Silva.
The situation has shifted, and Southport Athletic are also showing interest. You'll need to match their offer if you want to move forward.
We won’t be making a new offer until they adjust their price.
We’re looking for a package that reflects the value of the player, not just a number on a contract.
We’re raising our offer to 50M with the possibility of add-ons, and we’re ready to move forward if they’re open to negotiation.
We won’t entertain any more offers until they meet our initial demand.
We’re proposing a 4.7M annual salary with a 5-year contract as a clear and fair starting point.
That is not enough for us.
We’re willing to consider a 7.4M annual salary on a 4-year contract as a meaningful step forward, but we need a response that shows real commitment.
We’re pushing for a quick resolution and are ready to finalize this deal with a 6.6M annual salary on a 4-year contract.
We’re not holding back—our final offer is 72M, and time is running out.
We’re not moving on this, and Southport Athletic are also in the mix—so you’ll need to step up if you want to move forward.
That is still too much for us.
We’re pleased to accept the 7.4M annual salary on a 4-year contract as proposed.
We’re not making any new offers at this stage.
